summary: YYForce Inc. (formerly YY Group Holding Limited), a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a corporate name change and Nasdaq ticker symbol change from YYGH to YFOR, effective September 2, 2026. The change was approved by the board on August 19, 2026, and became effective upon registration with the BVI Registrar. No shareholder action was required, and the ISIN remained unchanged. This is a routine administrative event, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes; it merely reflects corporate rebranding.
